comment: Source review 5a: options.c handler_msgtype() (6518-6526) passes the typed message pattern to test_regex_pattern() (7871-7901); a pattern ending in a lone backslash fails regex_compile(), and config_error_add() outside a configuration read prints 'MSGTYPE regex: trailing backslash (\).'
